name: Team Bulbasaur: Sevii Ironbreaker Vanguard
archetype: Sevii archipelago & Rocket Warehouse raid — Fire incineration, Sleep status control, 4x Ground wallbreaking, Levitate Ground immunity, and Thick Fat sponge.
gym_duel_rationale: No gym duel in Chapter 21. All six party members deploy together in full 6-member syndicate raid configuration, storming the Rocket Warehouse to confront Executive Ariana and recover the stolen Sapphire under the Level 80 cap.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 80. STAB Flamethrower incinerates Ariana's Tangrowth/Vileplume and Skarmory/Combusken for effortless OHKOs. Sleep Powder neutralizes dangerous threats.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 79. STAB Hydro Pump washes away Arbok/Houndoom with massive force. Water Absorb provides continuous healing across the Water Labyrinth.
500 BST physical wallbreaker. STAB Close Combat crushes Skarmory/Combusken and normal-type meadow encounters. Crabhammer delivers colossal water physical impact.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Lowers enemy Attack on entry to blunt Rocket warehouse physical sweepers. Glare provides guaranteed 100% paralysis on fast targets.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to Earthquake via Levitate. STAB Psychic decimates Ariana's Tangrowth/Vileplume and Arbok/Houndoom for swift, decisive knockouts.
Colossal 160 HP route sponge holding Leftovers. Thick Fat halves incoming Fire attacks from Houndoom fusions. RestTalk loop absorbs deep-sea and warehouse status.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder for securing rare wild catches in Chrono Meadow.
Discharge and Light Screen to sweep Water Labyrinth water routes.
High Jump Kick physical breaker for Steel and Normal type warehouse encounters.
